description: Search the whole collection by title, author or tags (English or Spanish). Use it when you look for a topic or an artist and have no room id. Returns short results (id, title, author, date, rooms, URLs); open one with get_piece.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. 'blue spiral' or 'copa de coco'.

visitor_name.description: Your name as a visitor (max 40 chars). The same name always gives the same avatar, stamps and badges. Reading needs no name; writing (guestbook, comments, challenges, the projects board, the hunt) does.

name: search_pieces

results.description: Matching pieces: id, titulo, autor, fecha, salas, url, json.
